sloka: शलभा इव संछाद्य मेदिनीम् संप्रतस्थिरे ।रामः प्रस्रवणे तस्मिन् न्यवसत् सह लक्ष्मणः ॥४-४५-३॥
transliteration: śalabhā iva saṁchādya medinīm saṁpratasthire ।rāmaḥ prasravaṇe tasmin nyavasat saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥4-45-3॥

translations.english: Rama accompanied by Lakshmana stayed back at Prasravana mountain looking forward for the expiry of the month fixed for the monkeys to trace Sita's whereabouts.
